title: Property Tax Act (Cap. 81:21)
found: Statutory net wealth tax on net property of individuals and companies enacted 1962

title: Fiscal Enactments (Amendment) Act 2013
found: Shifted valuation date to 2011 and raised individual property tax threshold from GYD $7.5M to GYD $40M

title: Property Tax (Amendment) Act 2018
found: Raised individual and corporate filing threshold to GYD $40M and reduced rate to 0.5% on first GYD $20M

title: Fiscal Enactments (Amendment) Act 2024
found: Inserted Section 6(y) exempting individuals from property tax and return filing from income year 2025
